title: 'Read the founding ledger aloud' is advertised (status: 'to those who trust you') as needing only Watch/Church/Companies trust, which I had (Church 'in your debt', Free Companies 'a friend of the Companies'), but the option never appeared at the throne; it silently also needs the physical ledger from the Hall of Ledgers, which the throne-room text never says.
